correctness.rationale: Permutation averaging preserves feasible mass and PD Fourier positivity. The full Walsh transform of a B3-supported radial function is a cubic in S=d-2k; exact positive layer combinations yield F_0+dF_{(d-1)/2}+dF_{(d+1)/2}+F_d=2d+2 (odd) and F_0+2(d-1)F_{d/2}+F_d=2d (even). Constructed normalized nonnegative cubics attain each. For odd d>=5 equality annihilates S=+/-1 and S=-d; the two-central-slice inclusion-matrix factorization (separate d=5 interpolation) leaves (S^2-1)(c0+sum b_i s_i), and nonnegativity forces b_i>=0, sum b_i=1/(d-1), an injective full simplex. For d=3 B3=G and the constant function uniquely maximizes. For even d>=4 the radial equality zeros at S=0,-d and inequalities at +/-2 yield alpha in [-2,2] with exact normalization. A new exact-rational spot check verified proposed spectra for d=3..7, not all d.
